Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

CLOTHING & ACCESSORIES
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Cover-up / beach dress
- Casual outfits for daily activities
- Hiking gear (lightweight clothes, long pants for Diamond Head hike)
- Evening outfit for Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center
- Comfortable walking shoes / sneakers
- Hiking shoes / sturdy sneakers
- Sandals / flip-flops
- Water shoes (for kayaking and snorkeling)
- Hat / visor for sun protection
- Sunglasses
- Light jacket or sweater (for evenings)

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins) if bringing own
- Beach towel
- Dry bag for kayaking
- Rash guard / swim shirt

HEALTH & PERSONAL CARE
- Lip balm with SPF
- After-sun lotion / aloe vera
- Insect repellent
- Basic first aid kit
- Personal toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, body wash)
- Medications (prescriptions, motion sickness meds for road trips)

ELECTRONICS
- Camera (for capturing memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, Luau)
- Phone charger / power bank
- Waterproof phone case

IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS
- Travel documents (passport, ID, flight confirmation)
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Activity/tour booking confirmations
- Travel insurance information
- Credit cards / cash

MISCELLANEOUS
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach bag / tote
- Small backpack for day trips
- Umbrella (just in case)
- Snacks for road trips
- Book or entertainment for relaxation days
